lesson_title: LESSON 07: Sharing the Road & Special Circumstances
prompt: Why is parking in the striped access aisle next to a disabled parking space strictly illegal?

options.text: Striped aisles are reserved exclusively for municipal police motorcycles
Striped aisles contain underground high-voltage municipal utility cables
The striped aisle is required for wheelchair lift ramps to deploy safely
Parking on white paint strips causes accelerated automotive tire wear
